name: SAFIRA (BUKAN NAMA SEBENAR)
overview:
Nilam (played by Elvina Mohamad), a girl from a small town who never knew the meaning of despair. She did whatever part-time work like at a laundromat, or even anything she could to survive. In her busy life, her heart often imagined living a luxurious life like the wealthy. But everything changed when she met Datin Laila (played by Sazzy Falak), an elegant woman who saw hidden talent in her.

Every relationship that came her way taught her something: money without meaning is just empty. From there, Safira began to dare to pursue her true dream of becoming a fashion stylist who wanted to prove that style is not just for the rich, but for everyone.
